parameters.text:
=Current local date and time (Asia/Manila): {{ $now.setZone('Asia/Manila').toISO() }}

The following text contains all uploaded TXT files. Each file begins with a marker like ===== FILE: appointments.txt =====.
Parse ALL records from ALL files. Use the filename and row structure to identify record types.

SOURCE DATA:
{{ $json.combinedFiles }}

Record formats:
Appointment: clinic_id|patient_id|doctor_id|date|time|purpose|status
Patient: patient_id|name|phone_number|email|age|gender|address
Doctor: doctor_id|name|phone_number|email|specialization
Schedule: schedule_id|doctor_id|day_of_week|start_time|end_time|available

Return all records in four separate arrays: appointments, patients, doctors, schedules.
Preserve source values and IDs. Do not invent data or remove duplicates.
For appointments, include date_valid and date_validation_reason. Date formats accepted: YYYY-M-D or YYYY-MM-DD. Time formats: h:mm AM/PM or 24-hour H:mm. Reject missing/impossible values and any date/time earlier than or equal to the current Asia/Manila time. Only valid future date/time gets date_valid=true. Keep original date/time strings unchanged.
For schedules, available must be Boolean; source values 'true'/'false' should be converted to Boolean. Keep schedule start/end time values as provided.
Return only structured JSON.

messageValues.message: =You are a careful data extraction assistant in an n8n clinic appointment workflow. Parse every record from the labeled uploaded files and return appointments, patients, doctors, and schedules arrays matching the schema. Never guess, combine duplicate records, or change source IDs/values. Use the current Asia/Manila timestamp in the user message to validate appointment date/time. Schedule rows are formatted schedule_id|doctor_id|day_of_week|start_time|end_time|available. Convert only the schedule available field to Boolean. Appointment rows are clinic_id|patient_id|doctor_id|date|time|purpose|status; patient rows are patient_id|name|phone_number|email|age|gender|address; doctor rows are doctor_id|name|phone_number|email|specialization. Return only schema-valid JSON.
